def build(ctx):
    a = ctx.alloc(5)
    b = ctx.alloc(5)
    ctx.reg("a", a)
    ctx.reg("b", b)
    
    # Temporary qubits for carry chain
    c = [ctx.alloc() for _ in range(5)]
    
    # Compute carries
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c[0])
    for i in range(1, 5):
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c[i])
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c[i-1])
        ctx.ccx(c[i-1], a[i], c[i])
        ctx.ccx(c[i-1], b[i], c[i])
    
    # Sum bits (least significant first)
    ctx.cx(a[0], b[0])
    ctx.cx(b[0], a[0])
    ctx.cx(a[0], b[0])
    
    for i in range(1, 5):
        # XOR with carry
        ctx.cx(c[i-1], b[i])
        ctx.cx(a[i], b[i])
        ctx.cx(b[i], a[i])
        ctx.cx(a[i], b[i])
        ctx.cx(c[i-1], a[i])
    
    # Uncompute carries
    for i in range(4, 0, -1):
        ctx.ccx(c[i-1], b[i], c[i])
        ctx.ccx(c[i-1], a[i], c[i])
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c[i-1])
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c[i])
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c[0])

    a = ctx.alloc(5); ctx.reg("a", a)
    b = ctx.alloc(5); ctx.reg("b", b)
    c = ctx.alloc()                 # single carry ancilla, |0>

    def maj(i):
        # (a[i], b[i], c) -> (a^b, b^c, carry_out)
        ctx.cx(b[i], a[i])
        ctx.cx(c, b[i])
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(b[i], c)

    def uma(i):
        # (a^b, b^c, carry_out) -> (sum, b, carry_in)
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(c, b[i])
        ctx.cx(c, a[i])

    for i in range(5):           # forward: propagate carries LSB->MSB
        maj(i)
    for i in range(5 - 1, -1, -1):   # backward: uncompute carries MSB->LSB
        uma(i)

    ctx.free(c)
